messages.subject: Subread release 1.4.3
parts:
Dear All,

We have made a new release of the Subread package (version 1.4.3). Changes in this release includes:

(1) Support for gzipped FASTQ input was added.
(2) Improved indel detection.
(3) exactSNP can use known SNPs to improve its SNP calling performance (-a option).
(4) Bug fixes.

Best regards,

The Subread team
